title: reusable-code-audit
summary: An NHS England repository that audits other codebases for duplicated or reused code, storing extracted snippets as evidence of overlap between projects. One such extracted snippet, copied from SynthVAE's metrics.py, imports SDV's evaluation and tabular-metrics modules to compute synthetic-data quality scores.
